description: Marks a thread read or unread, moves it to inbox, archive, spam or trash, sets its status (`open`, `closed`, `archived`) or replaces its labels. Archiving files the thread in archive, and moving an archived thread anywhere else reopens it. Returns the thread.

folder.description: Move the thread to inbox, archive, spam or trash. archive also sets status "archived", and moving an archived thread anywhere else reopens it. sent cannot be chosen (422): a thread is filed there while every message in it is one you sent. A thread in trash is deleted for good 30 days after it was moved there.

label_ids.description: Label object ids (`lbl_…`). Replaces the thread's labels with those labels' names. Sent together with `labels`, the thread gets both.

labels.description: Label names, up to 50, each at most 64 characters. Replaces the thread's labels. Any such name works; a name that matches a label object picks up its id and colour.

read.description: Mark the thread read (true) or unread (false).

status.description: "archived" also files the thread in archive; "open" or "closed" on an archived thread moves it back to the inbox.

name: mails_threads_update
title: Update a thread
